sentences.text: Vuori Subsea Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-10-09 under the industry code 64210, activities of holding companies.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-10-11.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, so only the first business level is read and the rest are unknown.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name suggests an ocean link but the registered industry is a holding company, and no public record yet shows what it does.
